recipes.sourceCrs: World Geodetic System 1972 (WGS 72), official U.S. Department of State / Defense Mapping Agency realization
recipes.pointSemantics: official WGS 72 realization of the 1895 Pamir control network, explicitly inherited for the USSR by the 1958 frontier-regime treaty; controls are not a boundary polyline
recipes.note: Article 1 of the 1958 treaty keeps the Zor-Kul–China line under the 1895 demarcation protocols. MultiPoint is mandatory so legal continuity of the control network cannot be rendered as invented straight inter-pillar segments.
